description: This file is a code-behind for an ASP.NET WebForms page 'TheorySet.aspx', handling UI interactions such as course selection, adding questions, setting exams, and navigation within an online examination system. It interacts with a SQL database to store and retrieve question and course details.

classes.name: TheorySet
classes.description: Partial class representing the code-behind of the 'TheorySet.aspx' page, managing course selection, question addition, exam setup, and navigation in the online examination system.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles initial page load; currently empty with commented-out session code.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates 'SelectCourseDropDownList' based on selected semester, adding appropriate course options.

methods.name: AddQB_Click
methods.description: Inserts a new theory question into the database, updates question number, and provides confirmation alerts.

methods.name: setB_Click
methods.description: Creates a new exam record for the selected course in the database and notifies the user.

methods.name: clearB_Click
methods.description: Clears input fields for question data.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to 'LoginPage.aspx', effectively logging out.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates course options based on semester selection.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Fetches and updates question number for selected course.
